title: Estimated gamma background in the MACE ECAL crystal array

geometry.polyhedron: GP(8,0) first-kind Goldberg polyhedron (dual of class-I geodesic sphere)

interpretation.volume: the rate uses the summed volume of all N_CRYSTALS = 568 instrumented crystals (the ideal GP(8,0) has 642 faces; the detector has two gaps, upstream and downstream, so 74 cells are absent), i.e. V_total = N_CRYSTALS * V_cry.
interpretation.n_bkg: n_bkg = r_bkg * 100 ns is the expected number of background hits per event over the whole detector; step 5 draws that number and assigns each hit to a random crystal.

assumptions.dose: 1 Sv = 1 Gy for photons; the ambient dose rate is applied as the absorbed dose rate in CsI (no CsI/air mass-energy-absorption correction)
assumptions.spectrum: normal distribution, mean 5 MeV, variance 2 MeV^2, truncated at 0
assumptions.geometry: crystal = frustum between the mean inner and outer face areas of GP(8,0), V = L/3 * (S1 + S2 + sqrt(S1*S2)); total volume = 568 * V
assumptions.statistics: background hits are Poisson distributed in a 100 ns window
